subject: Purchase gating: evidence sampling and PO-exemption path for Quantak pilot
body:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantak.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@quantak.io>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot billing and PO requirement question

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo today. We are excited to kick off the two-week pilot next week. Quick question on procurement: our finance org prefers invoice-only terms for short pilots and small vendors. Do you require a purchase order for a pilot engagement, or is there a temporary invoice-only path we can use while we evaluate?

I attached our completed onboarding form and the security questionnaire for speed.

Attachments: quantak_onboarding_form.pdf, quantak_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Liam

Quantak Labs

Subject: Re: Pilot billing and PO requirement question

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Short answer: for short pilots we can often run a limited "invoice-only" path, but there are gating conditions we need to satisfy before we can waive the PO requirement. I'll outline what Procurement/Finance needs below so you can surface it with your team.

High-level options
- Standard: PO + terms (preferred for production or if you expect charges to be invoiced against a PO).
- Conditional invoice-only pilot: allowed for trials under $10k total spend, subject to evidence and a signed MSA or a short addendum and procurement approval.

Procurement gating checklist (what we need to confirm)
1) Completed onboarding form (received)
2) Security evidence (SOC2 report OR current security questionnaire answers) — received, but procurement may request clarification.
3) Legal sign-off or a countersigned MSA/terms (looping Legal: laura_bennett).
4) Forecasted spend and a single invoice payment path (card, ACH, or net terms once approved).
5) Point of contact for billing disputes and PO issuance cadence.

I copied Markus from Procurement and Priya from Finance to get their take on the evidence sampling and any temporary controls (e.g., monthly cap, prepayment) we should require. If you can confirm preferred payment method and expected pilot spend, that will speed approval.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 01:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot billing and PO requirement question

Hi Hannah / Liam —

Thanks — quick procurement input below. We can support an invoice-only pilot but only under a controlled "conditional no-PO" lane. To approve that we will need evidence sampling and one of the payment mitigations listed.

Required evidence sampling (minimum):
- Current SOC2 report OR completed security questionnaire with verifiable responses (we'll call out any gaps).
- Proof of corporate registration / W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent (for non-US).
- Contact and escalation path for billing disputes.

Risk mitigations for conditional invoice-only pilots (choose one):
A) Prepayment for the pilot amount (preferred)
B) Corporate card on file for auto-charges up to a pre-agreed cap
C) Signed MSA + Finance approval for net-30 on the single pilot invoice

Additional controls we typically add for pilots without PO:
- Monthly spend cap (we set a hard cap in our billing system)
- Pilot flagged in account metadata so Customer Success and Billing watch for overages

If Quantak can provide the SOC2 or clarify the security answers and indicate which mitigation option they'd prefer, Procurement can issue a short approval memo (template attached) and waive the PO requirement for this pilot.

Attachment: procurement_no_po_memo_template.docx (stub)

Markus Klein
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Pilot billing and PO requirement question

Liam —

Quick summary and next steps so nothing gets missed:
1) Quantak has two paths for the pilot: PO (fast if you can issue one) or conditional invoice-only (waiver required).
2) For a conditional waiver we need: completed onboarding form (received), security evidence (SOC2 preferred; questionnaire ok but may trigger follow-up), and a chosen payment mitigation (prepay, card on file up to cap, or signed MSA + net-30).
3) Procurement will prepare the approval memo once you confirm the payment mitigation and provide the requested evidence.
4) Legal (Laura) — if you're comfortable, please confirm whether a countersigned MSA or a short addendum will be sufficient for a limited pilot scope.

Action items for Quantak (requested within 48 hours)
- Confirm expected pilot spend (ballpark is fine).
- Indicate preferred payment mitigation (A, B, or C above).
- Re-send SOC2 OR confirm the questionnaire owner and when we can expect any follow-up evidence.

I'll hold the kickoff dates tentatively for next Tuesday and will not finalize until we have the chosen payment path. Happy to do a 15-minute call if that's easier.

Thanks —
